categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in manufacturing and sales of aluminum electrolytic capacitors, motor fans, and resistors. These products serve various applications including communications, consumer electronics, industrial electronics, automotive electronics, and power management. The company also engages in product development and assembly within these segments.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Key technologies include large-capacity, fast charge-discharge, high and low temperature resistance, vibration resistance, high ripple current tolerance, long life, and miniaturization for capacitors. Motor fans focus on high airflow, low noise, high pressure, and low current consumption. Resistors emphasize sulfur resistance, low temperature coefficient of resistance (TCR), high power, lead-free high voltage, surge resistance, and expanded automotive-grade specifications. Production involves advanced assembly, coating, and testing processes compliant with ISO and automotive standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves major international customers in communications, computer, automotive electronics, industrial equipment, and consumer electronics sectors. Key markets include telecommunications, industrial automation, automotive electronics, and consumer digital products. The company’s products are integrated into devices such as power supplies, servers, smart appliances, and automotive systems.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations and sales cover Taiwan, China, Malaysia, and other Asian markets, with significant exports to Americas and Europe. The company maintains production bases in Taiwan, China, and Malaysia to support global customers and ensure supply chain resilience. Sales distribution is predominantly export-oriented, with over 90% of revenue from overseas markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the passive electronic components supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and assembly of capacitors, fans, and resistors. It sources raw materials such as aluminum foil, electrolytic paper, and conductive polymers from upstream suppliers and delivers finished components downstream to OEMs and system integrators.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include developing high value-added niche products with enhanced performance such as long life, low impedance, miniaturization, and environmental resistance. The company emphasizes ESG and sustainability integration, automation of production, cost control through supplier collaboration, and digital governance. R&D focuses on advanced materials, energy efficiency, and expanding automotive and industrial applications.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of capacitors, motor fans, and resistors. The company sells directly to OEMs and distributors globally. There is no indication of subscription or licensing revenue; income is based on volume sales and product mix.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include Japanese firms such as Nippon Chemi-Con, Nichicon, Rubycon, and Panasonic dominating high-end capacitor markets. Taiwanese peers include Lelon Electronics, Yageo, and Kingtronics. Chinese manufacturers compete aggressively on price in mid to low-end segments. The company positions itself by focusing on quality, niche markets, and R&D to differentiate from low-cost competitors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$5.26 billion, a 9.42% increase from the prior year, with a net profit attributable to owners of NT$495 million and EPS of NT$4.55. The company shows stable growth, improving profitability, and maintains a solid asset base of about NT$14.86 billion with equity of NT$9.69 billion. R&D expenditure was NT$48.5 million in 2023, reflecting ongoing investment in innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes superior product quality, reliability, and brand reputation, supported by multiple international certifications (ISO9001, ISO14001, IATF16949). It leverages stable, high-quality raw material sourcing and diversified production bases to ensure supply stability and cost competitiveness. The focus on niche, high-performance products and strong R&D capabilities differentiates it from competitors, especially in automotive and industrial applications.
